verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI offers anti-detection browser features (undetected browser, managed browser, stealth mode) and session/profile persistence to reuse saved login states across crawls, which helps avoid bot detection and re-authenticate without repeating login each time. However there is no evidence of actual CAPTCHA-solving capability, and persistent auth profiles require an initial manual login to capture cookies/session state, so it doesn't fully eliminate manual intervention. Community commentary explicitly flags 'bot mitigation, login/session handling' as unsolved production concerns users must own themselves. Missing for 10: CAPTCHA-solving/bypass evidence, fully automatic login flow without prior manual session capture, independent proof of form-wall bypass.
